column_description: BIGSERIAL. Auto-generated unique identifier for processing record. PK = Processing(FlowRegistry).
TEXT. Reference to equipment used for data processing. FK to Equipment.
TEXT. Reference to site where data was processed. FK to Sites.
TEXT. Software application used for data processing. **NULL means processing software not specified or custom processing pipeline used.**. Example: RealityCapture.
TEXT. Storage location for processed data files. Possible values: Cloud, Local, Network.
TEXT. Backup status and redundancy measures. Possible values: Completed, In Progress, Pending.
TEXT. Data access level and security classification. Possible values: Confidential, Public, Restricted.
TEXT. Metadata standard compliance and format. Possible values: CIDOC CRM, Custom, Dublin Core.
TEXT. Coordinate system used for spatial reference. Possible values: CUSTOM, Custom, LOCAL, Local, WGS84, Wgs84, custom, local, wgs84.
TEXT. Elevation reference datum used for measurements. Possible values: Arbitrary, Local, Sea Level.
TEXT. Current processing stage or workflow step. Possible values: Aligned, Final, Meshed, Raw, Textured.
TEXT. Data processing throughput rate. Example: 2.3 MB/s.

JSONB column. Computing system resource utilization during data processing including CPU, memory, GPU usage and processing time
Fields: {"Flow_Hrs":"REAL. Processing time duration in hours. Example: 21.9.","Mem_Usage_Gb":"REAL. Memory usage in gigabytes during processing. Example: 70.3.","Proc_CPU":"BIGINT. CPU usage percentage during processing. Example: 81.","Proc_GPU":"BIGINT. GPU usage percentage during processing. Example: 84.","Remain_Gb":"REAL. Remaining storage space in gigabytes. Example: 983.5."}

JSONB column. Calibration and correction status for various processing components including camera, lens, and color adjustments
Fields: {"Cam_Cal":"TEXT. Camera calibration status and accuracy. Possible values: Calibrated, Invalid, Required.","Color_Tune":"TEXT. Color balance and calibration status. **NULL means color calibration not performed or status not documented.**. Possible values: Adjusted, Required.","Lens_Dist":"TEXT. Lens distortion correction status. Possible values: Corrected, Uncorrected, Unknown.","Station_Link":"TEXT. Total station integration status and connectivity. **NULL means total station not integrated or integration status not monitored.**. Example: Partial."}
